name: Business Model Canvas Modeler
description: Open .bmc files as a Business Model Canvas: fill the nine blocks, colour stickies by what matters to your team, write notes on what to test, and keep an agent's changes to the file merged with yours.

cover.alt: Miragon Modeler for the Business Model Canvas: business models from plain .bmc files, edited by you and your agents.
